name: Graylog
description: Graylog is a centralized log management platform for collecting, indexing, searching, and analyzing machine data and log events in real time.

environment.name: HOST
environment.description: The base URL of your Graylog instance, without the /api suffix (e.g. https://graylog.example.com).

environment.name: API_TOKEN
environment.description: Base64-encoded HTTP Basic credential for the Graylog REST API. Create an API token in Graylog (System > Users > your user > Edit tokens), then base64-encode the string "<token>:token" (the literal word token as the password).
